definitions.short: properly, to hollow or arch , i.e. (figuratively) close ; to shut
definitions.full: H1479. guph [ גּוּף ] verb shut, close (Late Hebrew id. , see NHWB i. 314, 352 ) — Hiph`il Imperfect jussive יָגִ֫יפוּ Neh 7:3 close (door, דלתות ).

occurrences.englishText: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”
